freeze_note: Written before any outcome calculation for this family in this task. Git/file timestamp and manifest capture actual write time. Earlier local research may have exposed market history; chronological holdout is not claimed globally pristine.
hypothesis: Recent sector-specific liquidity shocks partially reverse, after neutralizing trailing market beta.
source: Yahoo Finance public daily split/dividend-adjusted close, 2004-01-01 through 2026-10-02; raw closes and distributions retained for audit. No future outcomes requested.
signal: Residual_t,i = simple total return_t,i minus beta_(t-1),i * SPY simple total return_t. Beta is rolling252 covariance/variance excluding t. For horizon h sum last h residuals, rank cross-section with average ties, subtract5, reverse sign, L1 normalize. Raw diagnostic uses summed unadjusted-for-beta total returns. SPY weight=-sum sector weight*beta_tknown. Finally scale every ETF leg so total absolute target weight=1. No forecast alpha intercept subtraction.
execution: Signal computed after close t. Target established at close t+1. It first earns close t+1 to t+2 returns. All close fills carry spread/slippage costs; no same-close trading. Every day rebalance, including SPY hedge.
capital: Fixed $1 strategy capital/gross target; not daily NAV rescaling. Daily P&L is per initial fixed capital and statistics are arithmetic returns. Fixed-notional cumulative P&L drawdown is reported explicitly; no artificial reinvestment. Dollar-neutral sector ranks may have nonzero SPY hedge and hence net exposure. Excess return subtracts net risky weight times lagged annual short-rate ACT365, assuming capital cash and financing both earn/pay benchmark before the extra short carry. Restricted collateral may worsen realized financing. Finite capital, margin and capacity not modeled.

costs.turnover: Sum abs(new target close t - prior close target*(1+total_return_t)) across all10 legs. Opening and final liquidation included. Dividend-adjusted total returns assume reinvestment within each leg; real distributions are small unmodeled intraday cash-flow differences.

cash_benchmark: Public FRED DGS3MO 3-month Treasury constant-maturity annual percent yield, lag one business observation, carry forward only calendar/nonpublication gaps. Convert annual simple rate using actual calendar days/365. This is financing proxy, not traded cash index. No imputation of ETF prices.
inference: 10000 circular moving-block bootstraps,20 trading-day blocks, fixed seeds; daily mean and annualized Sharpe 95% intervals, HAC20 intercept and SPY-beta diagnostic. No parameter retuning after outcomes. Report both variants, no ex-post winner claim. Observations are daily, not counts of independent trades.
metrics: cost break-even bps after2% borrow carry
checks: all10 assets complete unique common dates no forwardfill
one-day extra execution latency already required
signal rank L1 and modeled beta neutrality
selection_rule: No further variants from this branch. A research candidate must be positive in both validation and holdout at5bp stress and have holdout base Sharpe CI lower bound>0; otherwise no validated edge. Sharpe2 is not assumed or targeted via tuning.
limitations: Yahoo vendor revisions and current adjusted history
sector index methodology and composition changed historically
ETF-level index adjacency, not stock-level S&P500 alpha
ETF borrow not historically observed; 2% imposed scenario
closing print executions and capacity assumed subject to explicit slippage
